attestations.text: CH'UNG-shih 崇實 (T. 子華, H. 樸山, 惕盦), Aug. 26, 1820–1876, Dec. 4, official, was the elder son of Lin-ch'ing [q. v.] of the Wanyen (完顏) clan and the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner. Though reared in a family of affluence, Ch'ung-shih was exceptionally modest and studious.
